prompt: Add chunk(items, size) to src/chunk.js. It splits an array into consecutive groups of at most size items (the last group may be shorter) and throws a RangeError when size is not a positive integer. It must not modify the input array.

checks.en: Hidden tests of chunk pass (even and uneven splits, empty input, invalid sizes, no mutation)
checks.zh: 隐藏的 chunk 测试通过（整除与不整除、空输入、非法 size、不修改输入）

checks.en: The project has its own test file for the function, and npm test passes
checks.zh: 项目中有针对该函数的测试文件，且 npm test 通过
